judge: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (model made by Anthropic), judge 1, blind, job A

method.frames: ffmpeg 4 fps over the full length, tiled 8x3 (24 frames = 6 s per sheet, 9 sheets per video); first 2 s at the native 24 fps tiled 8x6 (48 frames) for the opening criterion; frames reduced to 240 px wide for the sheets, so tiny mono labels were judged as legible-or-not at that size and at phone scale
method.audio: audio not transcribed (no ASR tool available to me: whisper, faster-whisper and vosk are not installed). Caption sync judged from caption timing against mouth movement only. Loudness with ffmpeg ebur128: F -14.0 LUFS LRA 2.4; G -14.1 LUFS LRA 2.5; H -14.0 LUFS LRA 2.4; V -14.1 LUFS LRA 3.9; U -14.0 LUFS LRA 2.5.
method.temp_folder: scratchpad jA folder outside the project
method.files_read: five mp4 files, jobA/BRIEF.md, blind/SHEET.md, JUDGEMENT_reviewer_jobB.json (format only), BRAND.md. Nothing that reveals an origin was seen; no file sizes, bitrates, encoder strings or timestamps were inspected.

reasons.opening_clarity: Frame 0 is the presenter talking with a 'AI VIDEO ON ONE GPU / SPEED VS FACE' title fading in at ~0.25 s, a '4.1X / 4-STEP SPEED LORA' card at ~1.2 s and word captions 'FEWER STEPS SHOULD MEAN FEWER'; topic and promise are clear by 2 s.
reasons.message_accuracy: 4.1X (1.2 s), 600 (~18-20 s), 147 (~28-30 s), 4-step LoRA and 20 steps present and consistent; count-ups pass through 488/598 and 34/136 as animation only; grid labels 267 s / 208 s could not be checked against TAKES.md.
reasons.pacing_structure: Hook, claim, 600 vs 147 evidence, side-by-side grid (~32-37 s), 'NOT MEASURED' caveat, 'check the face' conclusion, end card 'FIVE SETTINGS ONE FACE / FULL EPISODE ON THE CHANNEL' held ~4 s; no sales line.
reasons.legibility: Word captions are large (Anybody on a yellow band with dark text) and change in step with the mouth; but the four-up grid labels (~32-37 s) and the card sub-labels ('SECONDS A CLIP') are unreadable on a phone, and 'NOT THAT SIMPLE' and 'CHECK THE FACE' enter as a sliced glitch for ~0.25 s.
reasons.craft_polish: Result clips are full-frame crops of 16:9 material and a 4-up grid is tiny; a blank dark card with only the AI tag at ~45.3 s before the end card and a black last frame at ~49.6 s; entrance slice effects are brief.
reasons.brand_sound: Anybody and Spline Sans Mono, yellow only as a band behind dark text, AI tag intact on every frame checked; voice -14.0 LUFS, LRA 2.4 (even). Presence of quiet music not checked.

common_defects: Entrance slice/glitch on one or two key captions in every video; in G and U it persists for 1.25-2.5 s and hides the caption.
Tiny mono labels in the split-screen and grid scenes are not readable at phone size (all five).
Result clips (16:9 material) are shown as small tiles or heavy crops; G, V and U open on two almost identical talking heads with no title.
Count-up numbers pass through values that are not in the brief (animation only).
A black or blank last frame after the end card in all five.
separator: F and H put a title, the 4.1X claim and the captions on screen inside the first 1.2 s; G, U and V open on an untitled split with micro labels, and V also uses yellow as a text colour and U/G lose a key caption to a long slice glitch.
could_not_check: Audio was not transcribed (no ASR tool available); caption wording and sync were judged from the picture only.
Figures such as 267 s, 208 s, 2.2X, 2.9X and 'five settings' could not be checked: material/TAKES.md is outside what I was allowed to read.
Whether music or effects sit under the voice: loudness numbers were measured, but voice and bed were not separated, so I could not confirm that any bed exists or that it is quiet.
Frames were viewed at 240 px wide, so fine type at the real 1080x1920 size was judged by size, not by pixel inspection.
F and H looked identical on every frame I viewed; I scored what I saw each time and did not compare the files.
